runs.label: Full run — 6,432 objects
runs.description: Every object in AltText_YUAG.xlsx, run through the chai workflow in workflow/: the manifest's Classification and Medium tell the model what kind of object it is, the first image is fetched at up to 1600×1600, and each row records the model call's cost. 6,432 calls, 11.4 million tokens, $4.75, 87 minutes.
